human_instruction: Rename the Pi extension command semantics from builder-plan to builder-context. Add /kajiya-builder-context as the official command for preparing bounded Builder context from an existing human-authored task brief. Keep /kajiya-builder-plan only as a deprecated alias if low-risk. The command text must clearly state that Pi must not invent strategy, roadmap, or implementation plan; it only prepares bounded context for the Builder using docs/task-briefs/ISSUE_ID.json as source of truth.
forbidden_actions: Do not modify Python CLI files.
Do not change backlog/current-project state from the extension.
Do not remove /kajiya-builder-plan unless compatibility risk is clearly low.
Do not make Pi responsible for strategy, roadmap, or planning.
